title: Write-tool base and charge-state write over MCP
goal: NERV can change a battery's charge state through FPVBuddy, as a write it gates with the owner's approval
acceptance: FPVBuddy's MCP server (F-009-T02) gains a write tool that sets a battery's charge state through the F-005 core; it is annotated as a write (readOnlyHint false, not idempotent) so NERV gates it as an action needing the owner's approval (nerv:F-101-T10); invalid input is refused with the core's errors
A caller-supplied request id makes a retried call apply once; specs cover the annotation, a write, a retry and a refused input; the consumer tool table marks it as a write
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: the first write tool sets the shared annotation and retry-once pattern the other writes reuse; the request-id ledger carries the uncertainty. Not a measurement.
